title: Overall system workflow
steps: Administrator
Configure markets and classified stalls. Approve category rates and applicable policies.
Market personnel
Register the tenant and linked businesses. Save a draft when needed.
Assignment manager
Review the rental preview and confirm eligible occupancy.
Resolve missing approvals, stall classification or a conflicting assignment.
Contract officers
For eligible monthly assignments, draft, generate, review and issue through approval gates.
Keep the document at its current stage until eligible.
Billing officer
Generate complete monthly or fixed-day drafts, then review and explicitly post.
Collection officer
Record, allocate and post payments against eligible posted bills.
Correct invalid totals or unsuitable allocations.
Management / Treasury
Monitor reports, confirm reconciliation and review history.
note: Permissions govern each action. Occupancy, contract status and payment status are separate records.

title: Initial system configuration
steps: MIS / administrator
Complete authorized setup. Follow the rollout runbook for optional fixed-day terms.
Super Administrator
Create named active accounts and assign roles.
Keep one active Super Administrator.
Market administrator
Create active markets, sections and physical stall categories.
Stall manager
Register coded stalls with verified area and Inner or Outer location.
Verify unclassified inventory before new assessment.
Rate manager
Prepare dated category schedules and market rental policy drafts.
Rate approver
Review current terms and approve authorized revisions.
Reload changed drafts and review again before approving.
Layout / template managers
Save the market grid and arrange approved original DOCX review.
Issuance needs separate numbering, rental and review authority.
note: Seed schedules start as undated drafts. Market policies supply approved monthly terms and control concurrent occupancy.

title: Unified tenant and business registration
steps: Market personnel
Personal: enter verified identity, residency and contact details.
Market personnel
Identification: record accounts and verified ID details.
Market personnel
Add linked businesses and categories. Enter goods and references if known.
Market personnel
Choose an eligible stall and linked business. Add dates and available interval details.
Assignment officer
Rental preview: check the approved rate, coverage basis and payable rent.
Resolve missing approvals or verified stall information.
Market personnel
Helpers: enter up to two helpers per applicable assignment.
Assignment officer
Review: confirm authorized assignments or save a draft.
Follow the error link when shown, correct the field and resubmit.
note: Registration can generate tenant and agreement references. A saved draft does not reserve a stall.

title: Stall registration and assignment
steps: Stall manager
Verify area and Inner or Outer location in Stall Management.
Assignment manager
Choose an eligible stall, active tenant and owner-linked active business.
Application
Resolve the approved category rate and any required market policy.
Unclassified stalls and draft schedules cannot support an assessment.
Assignment manager
Enter dates. Supply an agreement reference or leave it blank for generation.
Application
For concurrent occupancy, check the reason and approved limits in each market.
Resolve missing reason, authority or conflicting occupancy.
Application
Save occupied assignment, agreement and frozen assessment together.
Authorized viewer
Verify the stall, assessment and assignment in the map or tenant profile.
note: Assignment can leave goods or services blank. Inner uses the approved minimum and Outer the maximum.

title: Lease contract generation and controlled issuance
steps: Draft officer
Select an active monthly assessment with verified goods or services and an approved template.
Complete the business details and review an eligible monthly renewal.
Generating officer
Verify current tenant identity, ID and authorized assignment helpers.
Resolve incomplete identity, template or checksum checks.
Application
Freeze current identity and helpers with assessed trade and rental terms. Store original DOCX.
Authorized reviewer
Compare original and generated pages. Record actual visual review.
Issuing officer
Check approved numbering, rental and advance/deposit authority before issue.
Keep the contract ready when issuance authority is incomplete.
Authorized uploader
Upload the executed signed copy.
Issuing officer
Activate within eligible dates and active occupancy.
note: If local PDF conversion succeeds, review that output too. Reprint downloads the preserved original.

title: Rental billing and payment recording
steps: Billing officer
Generate a complete month or aligned fixed-day draft.
Check eligibility, cycle, due date and coverage.
Posting officer
Review amount and coverage. Fixed-day CUSA is for reference. Explicitly post.
Collection officer
Enter payment date, method, reference and exact positive amount
Application
Check receipt history and allocate entire amount to tenant posted bills
Reject overpayment, duplicate reference or allocation mismatch
Posting officer
Review draft and post; allocations reduce ledger balance
Treasury / Accounting
Confirm unreversed posted payment against Treasury information
Authorized correction officer
Void draft or append posted reversal with reason; link replacement
Preserve original payment and correction history
note: Use one billing cycle per request. Every interval has its own bill and ledger balance. Treasury confirmation records reconciliation.

title: Renewal termination and separate occupancy closure
steps: Authorized contract officer
Review contract dates, status and assignment history
Issuing / closing officer
Expire an eligible lease, or enter a reason and confirm the named void or termination action
Do not close an already closed contract
Assignment manager
Choose transfer / renewal, or end assignment with reason
Application
Check saved bill coverage and the original term's billing boundary.
Choose an eligible renewal date and protect existing bill coverage.
Application
End old assignment, retain agreement history and mark stall vacant
Assignment manager
Renew or transfer using an eligible business and a fresh assessment. The new reference is optional.
Reject overlap; retain original occupancy if transaction fails
Contract officers
Create replacement contract only when dates do not overlap retained contracts
note: A fixed-day to monthly renewal needs an aligned fixed-day boundary on the first of a month. Contract closure and vacancy are separate.

title: User accounts roles and permission management
steps: Super Administrator
Open Settings then Users and Roles.
Super Administrator
Create or edit account name, unique email, role and active flag
Super Administrator
Supply confirmed password for new account; optional reset when editing
Application
Validate email, password and one of six existing roles
Follow the error link. The same account form keeps the safe fields.
Application
Protect last active Super Administrator and prevent self-disable
Choose another safe account or retain administrator access
Application
Hash changed password, synchronize selected role and record audit event
Account holder
Log in using email; active account and permissions govern access
note: No self-service profile or forgot-password screen exists. Permission editing is not a user-facing screen; roles provide defined grants.

title: Report generation printing and export
steps: Authorized viewer
Open Reports and select a report type
Application
Check the report’s own access permissions.
Access denied when report permission is missing
Authorized viewer
Set only the supported IDs, dates or assessed location for that report.
Application
Validate identifiers, date range and tenant ID for a statement.
Correct invalid filters and resubmit
Authorized viewer
Review paginated report results and interpretation
Authorized viewer
Choose CSV, XLSX, PDF or print output
Application
Export all matching rows only within 5000-row limit
Narrow filters when result exceeds 5000 rows
note: Exported tenant and financial information remains access-controlled information. Protect downloaded files and printed copies.

title: Complete operational lifecycle
steps: Administrator
Configure markets, classified stalls, approved rates and applicable rental policies.
Market personnel
Register tenant and linked businesses. Stage stall choices if needed.
Assignment manager
Confirm authorized occupancy. Review the frozen assessment.
Contract officers
For eligible monthly terms, draft, generate, review and issue where authorized.
Stop at unmet policy or visual-review gates
Billing / Collection
Post reviewed monthly or fixed-day bills and exact payment allocations.
Management / Treasury
Review dashboard, reports, outstanding balances and reconciliation
Assignment / contract officers
Renew or close contracts and separately end / transfer occupancy
Respect overlap and protected billing coverage.
Authorized reviewer
Retain assessments, posted records, original documents and audit history.
note: The lifecycle is a sequence across roles. No single ordinary staff role is authorized to perform every step.

title: Market Sections and stall selection
steps: Section manager
Open Market Sections and choose the market.
Section manager
Save code, name, display order and optional description or color.
Resolve duplicate names and codes within the selected market.
Stall manager
Search active sections in the stall form and save the stall.
Map viewer
Verify current section labels and occupancy counts.
note: Section changes preserve existing stall IDs and grid positions. Occupied sections cannot be deactivated.

title: Assignment rental override and prospective return
steps: Requester
Choose the monthly assignment and reference month in Rental Information.
Requester
Preview one method, enter the reason and submit full prospective months.
Separate approver
Review the proposal and policy coverage. Approve or reject.
Resolve missing coverage or exception authority before approving.
Billing and lease officers
Review the applicable terms before creating a new financial snapshot.
Authorized officer
If needed, return to automatic rent from an eligible future month.
note: Approved terms apply to the owning assignment only. Existing bills and contracts retain their saved amounts.
